title: Hotel F&B ops vs hotel PMS: what Hostora actually runs
description: Hostora runs restaurant, room-service, and banquet kitchen ops for hotels — not rooms, front desk, or housekeeping. Clear boundaries for buyers comparing systems.
body:
Hotels often ask whether Hostora replaces their property management system. The short answer: no.

Hostora is hospitality operations for F&B — outlet tills, kitchen display, room-service style tickets, banquet service, staff attendance on the floor. Rooms, front desk, and housekeeping stay with your PMS.

Where Hostora sits

  • Restaurant and bar outlets
  • Room service / banquet kitchen routing
  • Supervisor visibility during service
  • Optional local Docker server so outlets and printers stay on the venue LAN

Why the split matters

Buying a full PMS for kitchen tickets is the wrong tool. Running F&B on a consumer till app leaves banquet nights fragile. Hostora is the floor ops layer between guest demand and the kitchen — configured for hotel F&B, not rebuilt as a room system.
